correctness.rationale: From the actual frozen RESULT.md, P=[[1,-qz/(1+qz)],[-qz/(1+qz),qz^2]] is positive definite because det P=qz^2[1-q/(1+qz)^2]>0 for 0<q<1,z>0. Direct independent symbolic multiplication of both companion matrices gives exact E[A_D^T P A_D]-P=delta*diag(1,0), delta=z(qz^2+z-2)/(1+qz). The two-step expected squared-state form x^2+E X_1^2 is positive definite, implying geometric contraction at delta<0 and growth at delta>0; zero drift conserves positive expected energy. Independent centered noise adds sigma^2 to energy, giving the exact stationary variance in the stable region and critical linear energy growth. The separate mean-recursion Jury criteria yield the strict blind-spot interval; at q=1/2,z=3/2 roots have modulus sqrt(3)/2 although delta>0. Independent sympy calculation verified the drift, lifted-moment determinant, stationary MSE exactly. Scope is iid Bernoulli zero/one lag and real scalar convex quadratic, not general async SGD.
